control.note: paper baseline: vanilla ns-train splatfacto (eval/batch_run.py:186-207) on the same 1M sensor-depth points; isotropic log(mean 3-NN) scales + random quats, Splatfacto density + photometric loss, num_downscales 2 / resolution_schedule 3000. Paper Table 4 Splatfacto (L_rgb) 26.6 / .870.

paper_reference.source: tables/ab_our_supervision_strat.tex (VR room, 30k). Headline = test split (42 test.txt frames, within): every single-number MuSHRoom NVS table uses the within value (main_sfm_init, ab_2dgs_vs_dn_splatter_mono_sensor caption). validation (186 short_capture frames, cross) is secondary. No union (not an official metric). Paper delta +0.2 dB / +0.009 SSIM is within run-to-run noise; a tie is a valid outcome.

mushroom-vr_room._doc: MuSHRoom iPhone vr_room (zenodo 10230733). transforms.json explicit splits: train 376 long_capture frames, test 42 test.txt frames (within), validation 186 short_capture frames (cross trajectory; reported, never used for selection). points.npz = 1M official-style TSDF sensor-depth points; dnsplat/ sidecar (sensor depth, Omnidata v2 normals sha256 38db3f7d..., init scales/quats). Built by reproductions/dn-splatter/tools/prepare_mushroom.py (PYTHONPATH=~/models/dtueval-pylib:~/models/dpt/pylib:~/models/omnidata/pylib); NOT rebuildable by bench.py prepare.

notes: ss-train must get --data (sidecar lookup). Keep --num-gaussians >= 1M (init check) and --recipe splatstudio (3dgs recipe runs a 1Mx1M kNN that can OOM; scales/means-LR are set by the plugin anyway). ~0.18 s/step on a busy A6000 at 2k steps (more Gaussians later) -> ~1.5-2.5 h; peak ~1.5 GB at 2k, expect several GB at 30k; ~6 GB host RAM for 604 full-res images. Paper reports per-scene PSNR only for vr_room (Table 4); the 6-scene Table 3 average needs 5 more rooms (same tool, ~1.2 GB download) if wanted.

ablation.note: priors-off ablation, NOT the paper baseline: DN-Splatter renderer/density, oriented flat init, full-res training, photometric loss only.
